# PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE

## This practice direction supplements CPR Part 17

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > This practice direction supplements CPR Part 17] Contents of this Practice Direction

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > This practice direction supplements CPR Part 17] A party applying for an amendment will usually be responsible for the costs of and arising from the amendment.

## Applications to amend where the permission of the court is required

## 1.1 The application may be dealt with at a hearing or, if rule 23.8 applies, without a hearing.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 1.1 The application may be dealt with at a hearing or, if rule 23.8 applies, without a hearing.] 1.2 When making an application to amend a statement of case, the applicant should file with the court:

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 1.1 The application may be dealt with at a hearing or, if rule 23.8 applies, without a hearing.] (1) the application notice, and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 1.1 The application may be dealt with at a hearing or, if rule 23.8 applies, without a hearing.] (2) a copy of the statement of case with the proposed amendments.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 1.1 The application may be dealt with at a hearing or, if rule 23.8 applies, without a hearing.] 1.3 Where permission to amend has been given, the applicant should within 14 days of the date of the order, or within such other period as the court may direct, file with the court the amended statement of case.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 1.1 The application may be dealt with at a hearing or, if rule 23.8 applies, without a hearing.] 1.4 The amended statement of case should be verified by a statement of truth unless the court orders otherwise.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 1.1 The application may be dealt with at a hearing or, if rule 23.8 applies, without a hearing.] 1.5 A copy of the order and the amended statement of case should be served on every party to the proceedings, unless the court orders otherwise.

## General

## 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] (1) where the court’s permission was required:

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] Amended [Particulars of Claim or as may be] by Order of [Master …………][District Judge…… or as may be] [Legal Adviser] dated……………

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] (2) Where the court’s permission was not required:

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] Amended [Particulars of Claim or as may be] under CPR [rule 17.1(1) or (2)(a)] dated………………

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] 2.2 The statement of case in its amended form need not show the original text. However, where the court thinks it desirable for both the original text and the amendments to be shown, the court may direct that the amendments should be shown either:

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] (1) by coloured amendments, either manuscript or computer generated, or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] (2) by use of a numerical code in a monochrome computer generated document.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] 2.3 Where colour is used, the text to be deleted should be struck through in colour and any text replacing it should be inserted or underlined in the same colour.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] 2.4 The order of colours to be used for successive amendments is: (1) red, (2) green, (3) violet and (4) yellow.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > 2.1 The amended statement of case and the court copy of it should be endorsed as follows:] (For information about changes to parties see Part 19 and Practice Direction 19A.)

## Footnotes

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 17 – AMENDMENTS TO STATEMENTS OF CASE > Footnotes] See Part 22 for information about the statement of truth. Back to text
